description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual Intensive Care Unit (ICU) stays for patients. It links patients to their hospital admissions and specific ICU stay identifiers. The table includes data on the source database, care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge timestamps, and length of stay in the ICU. It can be used to analyze ICU utilization, patient flow, and length of stay patterns.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Source database for the data, either 'metavision', 'carevue', or 'both'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's first care unit during their ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU).

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's last care unit during their ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU).

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the start of their ICU stay.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the end of their ICU stay.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay in the ICU, in days.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ICUSTAYS references SUBJECT_ID (patient identifier) in PATIENTS
HADM_ID in ICUSTAYS references HADM_ID (hospital admission identifier) in ADMISSIONS
